summary: Verified fix for store WhatsApp templates editor. Backend: GET /api/messaggi-default returns all 21 keys (11 legacy + 10 new); PATCH /api/stores/{id} persists every new key and empty-string restore works (7/7 pytest pass). Frontend: admin login with 2FA TOTP, /negozi -> Sondrio Modifica -> Personalizza shows 21 textareas store-msg-* (incl. firma_ritiro, grazie_bolletta, vendita_arrivato, sollecito_ritiro, grazie_documento, grazie_altro) and 21 'Usa testo standard' buttons. Saved 'TEST grazie {nome}' in msg_grazie_bolletta -> toast 'Negozio aggiornato' -> persisted after page reload; 'Usa testo standard' fills default; restored to empty and verified empty after reload.

minor.issue: Review request mentions PUT but backend exposes only PATCH (PUT -> 405). Frontend correctly uses PATCH, so no functional impact.

StoreCreate/create_store only persist msg_privacy/msg_pronto/msg_recensione/msg_promemoria; when creating a NEW store, any custom texts typed in the other 17 fields of the editor are silently discarded (pydantic drops unknown fields).

issues: Placeholder (default text) is rendered with a gray very close to real text color; hard to distinguish empty-field placeholder from a custom value. Consider lighter placeholder (placeholder:text-slate-300/italic).

action_items: Optional: add the 17 missing msg_* fields to StoreCreate and create_store so custom texts are kept when creating a new store
Optional: lighter placeholder style in StoreMessaggiEditor textareas
critical_code_review_comments: create_store builds the doc manually with only 4 msg fields - use input.model_dump() to avoid drift with MSG_KEYS
update_store filters only None, so '' correctly resets to default - OK
seed_data_creation: None. Sondrio store msg fields modified temporarily and restored to original ('' / original values) - verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n0 (single TOTP login per module; parallel workers may hit TOTP replay). Store update endpoint is PATCH. Sondrio id abbe8ad2-8102-4951-b4f7-8db24634a205.
